👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, Delhi ke elections ek baar phir zor-shor se shuru hone ja rahe hain! Lekin is baar yeh sirf ek aam chunav nahi, balki ek mahayudh hai, jo politics ke naye daur ko tay karega. Is baar takkar sirf do nahi, balki desh ki teen sabse badi political parties ke beech hone wali hai!
Yeh chunav tay karega ki Bharat ki rajdhani par kiska parcham lehrayega.
10 saal pehle, jab Aam Aadmi Party ne Delhi ki kursi sambhali thi, tab unhone naye sapne aur naye vaadon ke saath ek kranti laane ka daava kiya tha—free paani, free bijli, free healthcare, free education, aur Yamuna ko saaf karne ka wada... Kejriwal ki party ne in bade muddon ke dum par apni sarkar banayi. Aur isi wajah se BJP aur Congress unhe taane marte rehte hain!!
Par doston, jo bhi political parties kahe, jab humne khud Delhi ki janta ke saath 5 din bitaye, toh hume yeh samajh aaya ki Aam Aadmi Party ne Delhi mein ek nayi soch ke saath ek nayi lehar shuru ki hai.
Aaj 12 lakh parivaron ko free paani mil raha hai, 10 lakh ghar subsidized bijli ka faayda utha rahe hain, aur 2 crore se zyada log free treatment ka laabh le rahe hain.
Lekin yeh kahani itni aasaan nahi hai. Kyunki elections sirf governance ke upar nahi, propaganda, marketing aur controversies ke sahare ladi jaati hain!!
Jab humne janta se baat ki, toh alag-alag kahaniyan saamne aayi. Ek taraf kuch log Aam Aadmi Party ko gareebon ka masiha maante hain, toh doosri taraf log yeh maante hain ki yeh sirf 'revdi culture' ke naam par paisa barbaad kar rahi hai.
Sach kya hai? Kisi ko nahi pata, kyunki mainstream media asli muddon ko chhod kar 'breaking news' ke tamashe mein uljhi rehti hai.
Par doston, humne ek mahine ki mehnat ke baad, Aam Aadmi Party ke netaon se lekar ek aam taxi driver tak, research papers se lekar live confessions tak sab kuch analyse kiya hai. Aur ab hum lekar aaye hain ek detailed report, jo asli sach aapke saamne rakhegi.
Kya Aam Aadmi Party ne apne vaade sach mein poore kiye?
Kya yeh vaade desh ke badlav ke liye the ya sirf chunav jeetne ki marketing strategy?
Kya Kejriwal sach mein paisa freebies mein barbaad kar rahe hain?
Aur in sab ka Delhi aur desh par kya asar ho raha hai?
